title: Cost of Government review of county boards
summary: In November 2024 the Cost of Government Commission began scoping a study of Maui County boards and commissions, and the homelessness commission's chair asked members to think about its value ahead of the review. In August 2026 the Cultural Resources Commission voted to send a response to a Cost of Government report that made four recommendations for it.

timeline.text: The motion passed with no objections.
The vice chair moved to send a response on the report to the Cost of Government Commission, with a copy to the County Council.
The vice chair said a Cost of Government Commission report made four recommendations for this commission.
The technical writer will send members sample study scopes.
The chair hopes to agree on a draft scope for the boards and commissions study at the next meeting.
The commission began talking about the scope, or plan, for a study of Maui County boards and commissions.
The interim chair said no one will be invited in for January so the commission can focus on its boards and commissions study.
